workingTree: Local baseline changes are uncommitted; see implementation notes.

checks.name: Angular document
checks.detail: Frontend serves the Angular entry document; browser interaction is not covered by this HTTP check.

checks.name: Gateway correlation header
checks.detail: The gateway preserves the supplied correlation ID.

checks.name: Persisted demo login through gateway
checks.detail: Login returned HTTP 200 and a nonempty token. Token and password are not saved.

checks.name: Correlated business log
checks.detail: Users business event contains the gateway correlation ID.

checks.name: JSON log
checks.detail: Business event parses as JSON and includes structured scopes.

checks.name: Prometheus scrape targets
checks.detail: Healthy jobs: api-gateway, otlp-collector, pharmacy-service, users-service; missing: .

checks.name: Successful business request metric
checks.detail: Prometheus contains successful /api/drug requests from the gateway; the direct scrape job is selected to avoid double counting.

limitations: Compose only; Kubernetes and physical-node compliance are not evaluated.
HTTP frontend check does not execute Angular in a browser.
ELK, complete tracing, alerts, chaos and model evaluation are outside this baseline.
